abstract: The presence of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) was studied in developing nervous tissues: rat cerebral cortex and neuroepithelial derivatives of a murine teratocarcinoma. AFP was localized by an indirect immunohistoperoxidase technique. Using serial dilutions of anti-AFP antibodies, the end-points of staining (minimal concentration of antibodies giving a positive labelling) were established. These points enabled the evaluation of the amount of stained AFP at different periods of development. In rat cerebral cortex, AFP showed one maximum amount on the 19th-20th day 'postcoitum' (in moderately differentiated structures), and two minima on the 13th-14th day (in primitively differentiated ones) and the 28th-29th day (in well-differentiated ones), respectively. Similarly, one maximum and two minima were established in the derivatives of teratocarcinoma imitating normal neural development.
abstract_ja: ラット大脳皮質およびマウス奇形癌の神経上皮由来成分の発生過程におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を検討した。AFPは間接免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法で局在を確認した。抗AFP抗体の段階希釈を用い、染色の終点(陽性染色が得られる最小抗体濃度)を求め、発生各時期のAFP量を評価した。ラット大脳皮質では、中程度に分化した構造に相当する胎生19〜20日に最大量を示し、原始的に分化した構造の胎生13〜14日と、よく分化した構造の胎生28〜29日に二つの極小を示した。奇形癌の派生組織でも、正常な神経発生を模倣して同様に一つの極大と二つの極小が認められた。
